intent: Build a personal finance dashboard: import CSV transactions, categorize them, show monthly charts, budgets with alerts, and export a PDF-style report.

spec.goal: Create a personal finance dashboard that lets a user import CSV transactions, categorize them, view monthly charts, track budgets with alerts, and export a PDF-style report.
spec.deliverable: A working personal finance dashboard app with CSV import, transaction categorization, monthly charts, budgets with alerts, and a PDF-style report export.
constraints: Transactions must be imported from CSV files.
Charts must show data on a monthly basis.
The report export must be PDF-style.
Do not add features beyond those listed in the request.
done_criteria: A user can import a CSV file of transactions and see them in the dashboard.
Each transaction is assigned a category.
Monthly charts display the imported transaction data.
A user can set budgets and sees an alert when a budget is reached or exceeded.
A user can export a PDF-style report of their finances.
spec.summary: You want a personal finance dashboard that imports CSV transactions, categorizes them, shows monthly charts, tracks budgets with alerts, and exports a PDF-style report.
